design_purpose.patch_metres: Fifteen-metre coherent lee-side patches separated by exposed rock.
design_purpose.patch_low: Seeded noise begins the low pocket edge here.
design_purpose.patch_high: Seeded noise fills the sheltered heart here.
design_purpose.shelter_reach_m: Read nearby original rises within four metres to distinguish lee pockets from open benches.
design_purpose.rock_fringe_m: Settled debris and established growth taper over five and a half metres from an existing parent rock footprint.
design_purpose.sparse_coverage: Only 2.5 percent low roots outside pockets keeps exposed rock legible.
design_purpose.pocket_coverage: 94 percent eligible roots in sheltered hearts joins broad growth masses.
design_purpose.scrub_share: A quarter of dense-heart plants use the woody low scrub form.
design_purpose.scrub_threshold: Scrub stays in protected patch hearts; edges stay below ankle height.
design_purpose.mat_share: One fifth of planted roots use low cushion growth to soften group edges.
design_purpose.debris_share: Up to 35 percent roots in strong parent/ledge bands carry shallow shingle; fragments replace a plant at that root.
design_purpose.max_scale: Largest ordinary tuft without altering authored silhouettes.
design_purpose.fringe_scale: Small edge plants fit narrow supported shelves when larger forms fail.
design_purpose.root_jitter_m: Small root offsets break grid rows while keeping deterministic cell ownership.
design_purpose.support_step_m: Full square footprints sample support at most 32 cm apart, including every crossed cell.
design_purpose.max_support_rise_m: Reject abrupt unsupported steps beneath decorative growth or shingle.
design_purpose.max_plane_error_m: Shallow forms follow the measured plane only when the whole footprint hugs it.
design_purpose.root_embed_m: Seat roots and shallow fragments 4.5 cm into the actual surface.
design_purpose.wind_bend_per_m: Quiet highland wind bend; included in footprint bounds.
design_purpose.ground_mix: Strong local weathered stone, lichen and pocket soil treatment in the exact highland surface mask.
design_purpose.cover_distance_m: Low highland detail fades at 78 metres; existing large outcrop distances stay unchanged.
